$comment: Merge policy for main, applied as GitHub repository RULESETS (managed via the API, visible in Settings > Rules). main-checks has no bypass actors: the Review gate (strict/up-to-date), linear history, no force-push and no deletion apply to everyone including admins. main-reviews requires 1 approving review (stale approvals dismissed, approval required after the last push, squash-only merges) and grants repository admins a pull_request-context bypass so either maintainer can ship their own green PR when the other is unavailable. Every bypass is recorded in the organization audit log.
